QuestInfo.name: [프리미엄PC방] 피로타파 메이플! 파이널
QuestInfo.0: NPC Lyn has a special service prepared for players who logged in from the Premium PC Cafe despite the summer heat.
QuestInfo.1:
The #i3996035##b#t3996035##k received from Lyn checks change in fatigue when playing from the Premium PC Cafe. 

Your accumulated fatigue can be checked at once if you keep the #r#t3996035# for 60 minutes#k, and Lyn will clear the fatigue if you take it to her.

But keep in mind that the #bsensitive fatigue measuring instrument will break if you log out#k.
QuestInfo.2: I took #i3996035##b#t3996035##k to Lyn and received a gift. My fatigue completely vanished. As expected, the Vita-C Maple!
